 THIS WRIT PETITION (CIVIL) HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 17.01.2024, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 WP(C) NO. 37424 OF 2023  ..4..
 JUDGMENT A. MUHAMED MUSTAQUE, J.
This writ petition is filed against land conservancy proceedings. One of the main contentions raised by the writ petitioners is that all encroachers were not given notice and the petitioners alone have been singled out. Therefore, as per interim order dated 21.11.2023, we directed the revenue officials to initiate action against all other encroachers. 
2. The petitioners constructed building encroaching upon the government land with absolutely no semblance of time. The petitioners would say that they have obtained an order from the Tribunal for Local Self Government Institutions as against demolition of the building and therefore, the land conservancy proceedings cannot be initiated. 
3. It is to be noted that the challenge before the Tribunal was against the order of the local authority,
alleging construction in violation of the Kerala Building Rules. This is a case, where WP(C) NO.
Biju vs State Of Kerala on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/50326565/
3 37424 OF 2023 ..5..
the land itself found to be government land and where the encroachers have put up construction. 
We find absolutely no merit in this writ petition. 
The writ petition is accordingly dismissed. We direct that the revenue officials shall remove all identified 56 encroachers in a time bound manner, at any rate, within a period of six weeks, with the assistance of police, if necessary. The District Police Chief shall ensure that necessary police personnel are deployed to remove such encroachers. 
Report in this regard shall be filed in WP(C) No.1801 of 2010. 
Sd/-
A. MUHAMED MUSTAQUE JUDGE Sd/-
SHOBA ANNAMMA EAPEN JUDGE bka/-

Therefore, as per interim order dated 21.11.2023, we directed the revenue officials to initiate action against all other encroachers.

2. The petitioners constructed building encroaching upon the government land with absolutely no semblance of time.
The petitioners would say that they have obtained an order from the Tribunal for Local Self Government Institutions as against demolition of the building and therefore, the land conservancy proceedings cannot be initiated.
3. It is to be noted that the challenge before the Tribunal was against the order of the local authority,
alleging construction in violation of the Kerala Building Rules.
summary.decision:
We find absolutely no merit in this writ petition.

The writ petition is accordingly dismissed.
We direct that the revenue officials shall remove all identified 56 encroachers in a time bound manner, at any rate, within a period of six weeks, with the assistance of police, if necessary.
The District Police Chief shall ensure that necessary police personnel are deployed to remove such encroachers.
